How to read this. A promise appears only if its exact words were found in the source document, character for character. An alignment verdict appears only if every vote it cites was checked in code against the legislator’s own record. Where the record cannot settle a question, this page says so instead of scoring it.

Where coverage stands. Campaign finance is loaded for all 50 states: 2730 candidates with FEC filings across 470 races. Promises have been researched in 1 state so far, because that step means reading each candidate’s own words rather than downloading a filing. This page shows which is which instead of leaving a district looking empty. Snapshot built 2026-08-16: 73 displayable promises and 3 alignment verdicts. Money comes from FEC filings; votes link to the House Clerk. Identical treatment, identical method, every candidate.
